# Micah 3 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 3:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Who-build Zion with-blood and-Jerusalem with-iniquity. |
| LOGOS | Who build Zion with blood and Jerusalem with iniquity. |
| PNEUMA | You are building Jerusalem on a foundation of murder and corruption. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:11 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Her-heads judge for-a-bribe, and-her-priests teach for-a-price, and-her-prophets divine for-money, and-upon YHWH they-lean, saying, "Is-not YHWH in-our-midst? Evil will-not-come upon-us!" |
| LOGOS | Its heads give judgment for a bribe; its priests teach for a price; its prophets practice divination for money; yet they lean on the LORD and say, "Is not the LORD in our midst? No disaster shall come upon us." |
| PNEUMA | Your leaders make decisions based on bribes. Your priests teach only for pay. Your prophets won't prophesy unless they're paid for it. And then you lean on the LORD and say, "The LORD is with us — nothing bad can happen to us!" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:3 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-who eat the-flesh-of my-people, and-their-skin from-upon-them they-strip, and-their-bones they-break, and-they-spread-[them]-out as-[meat]-in-a-pot and-as-flesh in-the-midst-of a-caldron." |
| LOGOS | Who eat the flesh of My people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones in pieces and chop them up like meat in a pot, like flesh in a cauldron." |
| PNEUMA | Yes, you eat My people's flesh, strip their skin, and break their bones. You chop them up like meat for the pot, like chunks of flesh in a stew." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:12 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore because-of-you Zion [as]-a-field will-be-plowed, and-Jerusalem [will-become]-heaps-of-ruins, and-the-mountain-of the-house [will-be] high-places-of [a]-forest. |
| LOGOS | Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed as a field; Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins, and the mountain of the house a wooded height. |
| PNEUMA | Because of you, Mount Zion will be plowed like an open field. Jerusalem will be reduced to rubble, and the Temple hill will be overgrown with thickets. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 3:7 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-seers will-be-ashamed, and-the-diviners will-be-disgraced, and-they-will-cover the-upper-lip, all-of-them, for-there-is no answer-of God." |
| LOGOS | The seers shall be disgraced, and the diviners put to shame; they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God." |
| PNEUMA | You seers will be humiliated, and you fortune-tellers will be disgraced. You will cover your faces in shame, because God refuses to answer you." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

| PNEUMA | I said, "Listen, you leaders of Israel! You are supposed to know right from wrong, |
